title: SafetyConnect
caption: A one-minute tour of the SafetyConnect app.
say: Here's a one-minute tour of the SafetyConnect app.

title: Home
caption: Your driving score, trips and rank for the last 7 days.
say: Your home screen shows your driving score, trips and rank for the last seven days.

title: Business & personal mode
caption: Pick your vehicle, or switch off business mode for personal trips. They stay private and don't count towards your score.
say: Pick your vehicle, or switch off business mode for personal trips. They stay private, and don't count towards your score.

title: Score breakdown
caption: Tap any score to see how it's calculated: focus, smoothness, anticipation and legal driving.
say: Tap any score to see how it's calculated: focus, smoothness, anticipation, and legal driving.

title: What to improve
caption: See what to work on, like 41 harsh accelerations this week, plus quick safety tips.
say: The app tells you what to work on, like forty-one harsh accelerations this week, and shares quick safety tips.

title: Trips
caption: Every trip is recorded automatically, with its own score and distance.
say: Every trip is recorded automatically, with its own score and distance.

title: Trip details
caption: See the route, and exactly where each unsafe event happened.
say: Open a trip to see the route, and exactly where each unsafe event happened.

title: Reports
caption: Weekly and monthly reports track your score, risky events, distance and emissions.
say: Weekly and monthly reports track your score, risky events, distance, and emissions.

title: SOS
caption: In an emergency, slide to alert your emergency contact, or call 112.
say: In an emergency, slide to send an S O S alert to your emergency contact, or call one one two.

title: Documents & languages
caption: Keep vehicle documents handy, and use the app in your own language.
say: Keep your vehicle documents handy, and use the app in your own language.
